$Comment: The first beat of Ranger Wren's Kweebec Nightmares arc: survive one round of the co-op horror
minigame and come back to tell her about it.
The hytale:mod_installed factor reads 1 while the Kweebec Nightmare mod is loaded and 0 while it
is not, so the Min 1 bound is what shuts this quest on a server without that mod: it is never
offered and never shows up in a list. Keep the bound - a condition with no bound at all is
satisfied by the 0 too. Param is the mod's Group:Name exactly as its manifest spells it.
INSTANCE_ROUND_WON counts a round the player's side WON. Target is <modId>:<modeId> and
MatchMode PREFIX makes the bare 'kweebec:' prefix mean any of that mod's modes, co-op or PvP,
so a new mode counts the day it ships. Write the full 'kweebec:chase' with MatchMode EXACT to
pin one mode instead. Leaving Qualifier out accepts any difficulty preset.
Hidden plus RequirePrerequisites keeps the whole arc out of sight until Proving Day is behind
the player, so the campaign does not spoil itself.
